data.body:
AC amendment: Exec/source contract between dispatcher and strategy scripts

Add to AC: (a) dispatcher uses 'exec ${_SCRIPT_DIR}/merge-to-main-{strategy}.sh "$@"' to forward ALL argv including --resume, --bump; (b) export MERGE_STRATEGY before exec so _state_init can read it; (c) strategy scripts inherit all env vars including CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, PROJECT_ROOT, ARTIFACTS_DIR; (d) exit code passthrough is automatic via exec; (e) SIGURG trap is owned by the strategy script (only direct mode has phases/state, pr stub has none). Add AC: 'verify dispatcher invocation uses exec not subshell: grep -q exec plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh'
